All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created with title `dpm2 RD Bench Ticket`, assigned reference **RD-1015** (URL `#/tickets/t15`), customer "Bench Customer", created 2026-08-24. It appeared in the tickets list after the create mutation settled.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `dpm2 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. The app computed a price of **$125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `dpm2 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. The app computed a price of **$250.00**. (Ticket total at that point: $375.00.)

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost was edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). The app recomputed the price to **$187.50**. (Ticket total then: $437.50.)

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The ticket ends in status **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier set.** Clicking "Mark Ready" with unsupplied parts produced an alert reading:
> Ticket is not ready
> - Part "dpm2 RD Part A" has no supplier
> - Part "dpm2 RD Part B" has no supplier

I satisfied it by editing each part and filling the Supplier field with "Acme Parts Co" for both. After that, "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status badge changed from Draft to **Ready** (the button set changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed" / "Archive ticket").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts were deleted via their Delete buttons plus the confirmation dialog ("Delete the part "dpm2 RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone." → "Delete part", and the same for Part B). The parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket"; the detail page now shows Status: **Ready** plus an **Archived** badge, and the button changed to "Unarchive ticket". In the tickets list with "Show archived" unchecked, the count returned to "Showing 1–10 of 13" and no `dpm2` ticket was present; with "Show archived" checked, RD-1015 appears with the "Archived" tag, status Ready, and 0 parts. Nothing created by this run remains active.
